name: Leaning Barn Farm U-Pick
description: In Esko, MN, Leaning Barn Farm U-Pick raises Blueberries, Raspberries, Tomatoes, Asparagus, and Honey on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
